Margaritas can cause harsh hangovers due to a combination of **dehydration** from the alcohol, **irritation from high sugar** levels (from commercial mixes, triple sec, or heavy syrups), and the ease of drinking them quickly.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX13adKypi2BLGxeRpCYq3zs5bWmtJCTGTZJq_KBZUTThKDLKJNJsCPHmID4r_Zb33y4qmO87N2ERC_iGLo4EuETpebq0A9v0hNxZL0oBwYsX7VfpyHKmFq07zSwQn4zDqAzsgfqLusg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12BW-W0YHQZiNN1oIS0r6QHaN9fxyD-FO8-zOasROxhrI0GBK132Ral1P_Dxmj9HM2WLwi4RS_3rJdt-0duMCGU5v5OnP-CaLKlHjKR8f7_9AWmtaB0WDqosN3m-pVXvwosJ4cZpPADsEB1Hh0l2gHihKPphqdfc7v2FnHJ9yq00feEwl3dELxo6ykxLaxtt)

### Why Margarita Hangovers Are Severe

- **Sugar and Additives:** Cheap store-bought mixes or heavy corn-syrup-based liqueurs spike your blood sugar and worsen next-day inflammation and headaches.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXdkPXjkAA245luBXN_amXqFvoiNwM3KoD8xXI2xmrEvtHI0NDd1fsN48YYjlXmoSUbXprSSu6rR-kYnrAqYN6fQnRjTHShpD_A9STtzMHdfXg2k4RUUDwhz_EK0MQkA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX13adKypi2BLGxeRpCYq3zs5bWmtJCTGTZJq_KBZUTThKDLKJNJsCPHmID4r_Zb33y4qmO87N2ERC_iGLo4EuETpebq0A9v0hNxZL0oBwYsX7VfpyHKmFq07zSwQn4zDqAzsgfqLusg)
- **Dehydration:** Alcohol is a diuretic, and the salt rim combined with sweet citrus can accelerate fluid loss if you aren't matching drinks with water.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1y38qUdTbuBKEY2PUYPS5A1liHJovTd13nmATSXXwCNctd62Yv2hCeyLgrDc35P-xxzgKBNKwCUMqeR1OT1M64Wgw9iKfVzpZCdtJxofuHTpbnD6727mVO0hlbESzdxjWM0WHWbwjq1FFYtb504YJnQe7n5v80C6nkdtSHfD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12BW-W0YHQZiNN1oIS0r6QHaN9fxyD-FO8-zOasROxhrI0GBK132Ral1P_Dxmj9HM2WLwi4RS_3rJdt-0duMCGU5v5OnP-CaLKlHjKR8f7_9AWmtaB0WDqosN3m-pVXvwosJ4cZpPADsEB1Hh0l2gHihKPphqdfc7v2FnHJ9yq00feEwl3dELxo6ykxLaxtt)
- **Pace:** Because they are sweet and refreshing, margaritas are easy to overdrink faster than standard spirits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXX13adKypi2BLGxeRpCYq3zs5bWmtJCTGTZJq_KBZUTThKDLKJNJsCPHmID4r_Zb33y4qmO87N2ERC_iGLo4EuETpebq0A9v0hNxZL0oBwYsX7VfpyHKmFq07zSwQn4zDqAzsgfqLusg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12BW-W0YHQZiNN1oIS0r6QHaN9fxyD-FO8-zOasROxhrI0GBK132Ral1P_Dxmj9HM2WLwi4RS_3rJdt-0duMCGU5v5OnP-CaLKlHjKR8f7_9AWmtaB0WDqosN3m-pVXvwosJ4cZpPADsEB1Hh0l2gHihKPphqdfc7v2FnHJ9yq00feEwl3dELxo6ykxLaxtt)



---

### How to Recover From a Margarita Hangover

- **Rehydrate:** Drink large amounts of water, coconut water, or an electrolyte solution like Gatorade or Pedialyte.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXDtSgg-u_8gm6fcWRiRPnQfcOxfp6GswwIk5VVtVTwXAdaiSMo8290MTkAn5cOPUy-4RJFWRVhTPeSmq9vZzqQ7U66MrffROhWmV9ri5ClDs5ruKR5LFDpkBbYADwpEMBF-LtVBhqnzTuLbnHmTM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXZ-HSJED0pR6oGOCdIAAPQty26sVAmhQra0qlaLUWjqmHIjkfYmXaNEJp78p7l66m_QCf0Pg0U6mZuBHrng4G5lb_q_h8bycc0RfUoCT8ZMFqkwIVAzGYO3W2UypudiUam1QjS4gZtMnQu-xGGceYrNC_tK5n9jPqmec)
- **Settle Your Stomach:** Eat bland, gentle foods like saltines, toast, or a light broth before taking any pain relievers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXZ-HSJED0pR6oGOCdIAAPQty26sVAmhQra0qlaLUWjqmHIjkfYmXaNEJp78p7l66m_QCf0Pg0U6mZuBHrng4G5lb_q_h8bycc0RfUoCT8ZMFqkwIVAzGYO3W2UypudiUam1QjS4gZtMnQu-xGGceYrNC_tK5n9jPqmec)
- **Manage Pain:** Take ibuprofen *after* eating some food if you have a pounding headache.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXZ-HSJED0pR6oGOCdIAAPQty26sVAmhQra0qlaLUWjqmHIjkfYmXaNEJp78p7l66m_QCf0Pg0U6mZuBHrng4G5lb_q_h8bycc0RfUoCT8ZMFqkwIVAzGYO3W2UypudiUam1QjS4gZtMnQu-xGGceYrNC_tK5n9jPqmec)
- **Rest:** Give your body time to process the remaining toxins by resting in a cool, dark room.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXZ-HSJED0pR6oGOCdIAAPQty26sVAmhQra0qlaLUWjqmHIjkfYmXaNEJp78p7l66m_QCf0Pg0U6mZuBHrng4G5lb_q_h8bycc0RfUoCT8ZMFqkwIVAzGYO3W2UypudiUam1QjS4gZtMnQu-xGGceYrNC_tK5n9jPqmec)



---

### How to Make a "Lower-Hangover" Margarita
If you want to enjoy a margarita with a lower risk of a severe hangover, focus on clean ingredients and portion control:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12BW-W0YHQZiNN1oIS0r6QHaN9fxyD-FO8-zOasROxhrI0GBK132Ral1P_Dxmj9HM2WLwi4RS_3rJdt-0duMCGU5v5OnP-CaLKlHjKR8f7_9AWmtaB0WDqosN3m-pVXvwosJ4cZpPADsEB1Hh0l2gHihKPphqdfc7v2FnHJ9yq00feEwl3dELxo6ykxLaxtt)

- Use **100% agave tequila** (avoid "mixto" tequilas which contain other sugars).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXqjxmBnJKPTuS5UHChnXSBaR_GnmncFjRdH0HgeWdwPDOb6aEfFr7WJGpmteDIR5k4v8ViLt7uS05wDhGU4HUU3oUtQhzdwWXZ20mcOsdIx9ctKhtnCV44xN4IjhoTpqtYz42h04K)
- Swap heavy triple sec or artificial mixes for **fresh lime juice** and a small splash of **pure organic agave syrup** or a touch of orange juice instead of sugary commercial sweet-and-sour.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXTItJgJ4OI_J374Y9M4nr59UPxbsCHKoow_bfbERm535Fgw1-YPCCiY3JB6uJkmUFlIEnHctgq7rodzbMjbgEdPnThAdXA-EZ784qPsKCT1ZSzbUfDPnOIEKljm1U-9Jb0l4CkTbLLORyAUtPWWGeLwIUqksEahuGsGQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXdkPXjkAA245luBXN_amXqFvoiNwM3KoD8xXI2xmrEvtHI0NDd1fsN48YYjlXmoSUbXprSSu6rR-kYnrAqYN6fQnRjTHShpD_A9STtzMHdfXg2k4RUUDwhz_EK0MQkA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXqjxmBnJKPTuS5UHChnXSBaR_GnmncFjRdH0HgeWdwPDOb6aEfFr7WJGpmteDIR5k4v8ViLt7uS05wDhGU4HUU3oUtQhzdwWXZ20mcOsdIx9ctKhtnCV44xN4IjhoTpqtYz42h04K)
- Drink **a full glass of water** in between every margarita.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlAEBxCJF12BW-W0YHQZiNN1oIS0r6QHaN9fxyD-FO8-zOasROxhrI0GBK132Ral1P_Dxmj9HM2WLwi4RS_3rJdt-0duMCGU5v5OnP-CaLKlHjKR8f7_9AWmtaB0WDqosN3m-pVXvwosJ4cZpPADsEB1Hh0l2gHihKPphqdfc7v2FnHJ9yq00feEwl3dELxo6ykxLaxtt)
